hiw.title: How LiveGuard works
hiw.whyTitle: Why playful exercises instead of a photo or your voice?
hiw.whyText: A face or a voice can be stolen — a photo, a recording, a deepfake. The way you react, tap, and remember is far harder to imitate. And most importantly: it avoids collecting sensitive biometric data nobody wants to give away.
hiw.badDayTitle: What if I'm having a bad day, or a new phone?
hiw.badDayText: No worries. The system adapts to you — this isn't a test to pass or fail. It gently learns how you interact, without ever blocking you for a bad day.
hiw.privacyText: LiveGuard only collects timing and movement patterns. Never the content.
